response.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804;

assumptions.assumption: The bytes-per-millisecond average is the average of each qualifying track's decimal ratio; tracks with zero milliseconds are excluded from that average.
